summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) chart tooltip color bug fix and (2) new dark/light theme toggle, plus regression across all app pages. BOTH TARGETED CHANGES VERIFIED PASSING. Chart tooltip items render rgb(255,255,255) white text with rgb(0,229,255) cyan label header and rgb(11,19,43) dark background on Dashboard (2 charts) and Analytics (18 charts sampled 4) — including in light-mode where charts intentionally retain dark backgrounds. Theme toggle at [data-testid='theme-toggle'] flips html[data-theme] between dark/light, persists to localStorage 'nk_theme', survives reload, and switches body/sidebar to white bg with dark text in light mode. Regression: all 11 primary routes load without pageerrors and with sidebar mounted (Map + Users no longer crash), Command palette opens with both Meta+K and Ctrl+K, WebSocket wss://.../api/ws/live opens successfully, KPI total FIRs = 4,891 (>=4000).

integration_issues.issue: Trigger button is present and clickable, but after click no element matching [data-testid='ai-panel'] or [class*='ai-panel'] was found in DOM. Likely the panel container is testid-less or uses a different data-testid — not verified as broken, needs a stable testid. LOW priority (Ctrl+K palette and Kavacha AI page work).

issues: Recharts logs repeated dev warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — cosmetic console noise from ResponsiveContainer mounting before layout; no functional impact.
THREE.js console warning: 'Multiple instances of Three.js being imported' — duplicate three imports (likely from both react-force-graph-3d and a direct three import). Optimization opportunity.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Add data-testid='ai-panel' to the contextual AI side-panel container so its open state can be asserted deterministically.
(Optional) Clean up recharts ResponsiveContainer 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings — likely add minHeight/minWidth on parent containers.
(Optional) De-dupe Three.js imports to eliminate 'Multiple instances of Three.js' warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeProvider in /app/frontend/src/lib/theme.jsx is clean and correct (localStorage-backed, sets data-theme on <html>).
All Recharts Tooltip components now pass contentStyle/itemStyle/labelStyle per the requested contract. Confirmed via computed styles in the browser.
Previous crash bug (async useEffect returning Promise on Map/Users) has been resolved — both pages load with sidebar intact.
